Your rows
Press ◀ ▶ to move along a row and ▲ ▼ to change rows. Press OK on a poster to open it, or hold OK for more options.
At a glance
The top of Home shows details about whichever poster you\'re on.
The menu
Everything in WeaselPlex starts here. Press ◀ from the first poster in a row to open it, or press BACK on Home.
Who\'s watching
Your profile. Select it to switch to someone else.
Find movies and shows by typing, or use the mic button on the Search page.
Brings you back to Home from anywhere. Selecting it while you\'re on Home refreshes your rows.
Titles you\'ve saved for later. To add one, hold OK on its poster.
Ask for a movie or show that isn\'t here yet, then follow it in History.
Your libraries
Browse everything in one place at a time, like all the movies or all the TV shows.
Change how WeaselPlex looks and plays. You can take this tour again from Settings → Help.
